summary.text: Mike Cheokas is a Republican state representative from Americus who represents Georgia House District 151 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He faces Democrat James Wolfe and independent Travis Lockhart.

paragraphs.text: According to Ballotpedia, he previously served in the Georgia House from 2005 to 2017, representing District 138, and his tenure in the House is listed as beginning again in 2019.

Following the 2010 election he switched his party affiliation from Democrat to Republican; he stated, "My fiscally conservative voting record reflects that effort and the views of my constituents, which ultimately led me to join the House Republican Caucus."
Cheokas won the 2018 general election in District 138 over Bardin Hooks and the 2020 general election over Marc Arnett.
In District 151 he defeated Joyce Barlow in the 2022 general election and won re-election in 2024.

For the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Appropriations, Code Revision, Creative Arts and Entertainment, Education, Public and Community Health, Small Business Development and Special Rules committees, and he chairs the Small Business Development Committee.
